author: agent:claude-code
rationale: vg-paradigms answered graft 01a10afb: leaving the exception out of the manifest is deliberate (it only adds permissions; Cargo's license field is SPDX 2.3, which has no AdditionRef-), and LICENSE.md and REUSE.toml state the full grant. Cargo.toml already says what the baseline asks, so nothing changes here.

ops.title: The manifest leaves out the GPL exception on purpose
ops.body: Cargo.toml says GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0 while LICENSE.md and REUSE.toml grant GPL-3.0-only WITH AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0. vg-paradigms (graft 01a10afb) keeps it so: the exception only adds permissions, and Cargo's license field takes SPDX 2.3, which has no AdditionRef- identifiers. Unverified there: whether crates.io refuses the WITH clause; if a publish ever shows it doesn't, the baseline moves every project to the full expression.
